questions.q: When the imam goes into ruku', you ...
questions.a: A) Go into ruku' after him. We follow the imam, moving after him.

questions.q: Which comes straight after Maghrib?
questions.a: A) Isha. Maghrib is at sunset; Isha is the night prayer.

questions.q: What do we say in sujud?
questions.a: A) Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la. In sujud we glorify Allah, the Most High.

questions.q: Wudu is a ...
questions.a: A) Condition. Wudu is done before salah, so it is a condition.
